text: The Director, Arts and Culture Services, Economic Development and Culture will present a draft work plan for the Committee's consideration. On November 29, 2019, the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee requested the Director, Arts and Culture Services, Economic Development and Culture to develop a work plan based on the comments and suggestions made during the discussion on Item FA1.6.

The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Economic and Community Development Committee request the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to invite City officials, together with representatives from the Université de l'Ontario français, to present to the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee in 2020 on the City's role in the implementation and start-up phase of the project. 2. The Economic and Community Development Committee request the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to provide an overview of current partnerships with other cities and countries, including any memorandums of understanding currently in place to the June 12, 2020 meeting of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee. 3.
